description: This Java enum defines various file formats (INVALID, XLS, PDF, CSV) for report mailing email attachments in the Fineract project. It includes methods to get instances based on string value or integer id, and provides accessors for its properties.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobEmailAttachmentFileFormat
classes.description: Enum representing file formats for email attachments related to report mailing jobs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method returning the enum instance corresponding to a given String value ('xls', 'pdf', 'csv') or Integer id (1, 2, 3). Defaults to INVALID.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the human-readable value associated with the enum value.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the integer ID associated with the enum value.

methods.name: validValues
methods.description: Returns an array of valid IDs for the enum instances (XLS, PDF, CSV).
